data.name: Trixx
data.description: Taboo shattering, searingly honest, and painfully funny, Frankie “TRIXX” Agyemang is one of North America’s rising comedic stars. Trixx is the 2021 winner of the Boston Comedy Festival, the 2018 Winner of the World Series of Comedy, also 2013 Winner of Just for Laughs’ JFL42 Big Break Competition. He’s been featured on Kevin Hart’s LOL Network, Sirius XM Radio and has opened for such stars as: Tracy Morgan, Damon Wayans, Cedric the Entertainer, Mike Epps, Ryan Hamilton and Sugar Sammy Trixx has written and performed sold out theatre shows including his last show, a two-hour solo show, TRIXX: Unspoken Words, was sold out Toronto’s Jane Mallett Theatre. He has also performed internationally including: London, Boston Comedy Festival, Jamaica Comedy Festival and New York Comedy Festival. Trixx also performed regularly at such top venues as the Just for Laughs Comedy Festival, New York Comedy Festival, The Canadian International Comedy Fest and at Kenny Robinson’s Nubian Disciples of Pryor Comedy Show. Trixx has developed a cult following with his no-holds-barred, take-no-prisoners brand of comedy. Mixing boisterous commentary on topics like pop culture, relationships, music, clubbing, and sex, with acute insights on being black in North America, Trixx’s streetwise, boundary-pushing humour is unafraid of taking on everyone and everything in his sights. A talented entertainer, Trixx got his nickname through his reputation as a prankster while growing-up in Mississauga, Ontario. A former club DJ and MC, Trixx has been an on-air personality on Toronto’s FLOW 93.5 and was a regular on MuchMusic’s Video On Trial. In 2013, he was honoured for a second time with the Comedy Award from COCA. He was also a finalist in the 2009 Great Canadian Laugh Off.

data.description: JIM SPINNATO has spent more than three decades turning nightclub stages into scenes of chaos, laughter, and genuine disbelief. SPINNATO now headlines his all-new Anything Goes Magic Show weekly at Comix Roadhouse — Thursday and Friday at 5pm, Saturday at 4pm, Sunday at 5pm — with his Comedy Hypnosis Show running bimonthly. Strictly 18+, the show trades rabbits and wands for stand-up comedy, audience roasting, and unpredictable, mind-blowing magic built for a rowdier crowd. He's also brought the act to the Garde Arts Center, Six Flags New England, UConn, Providence College, Post University, and dozens of corporate and private events across New England. His TV direction includes his series, Misfits and Monsters, Jimmy Kimmel Live, Community, Maron, Those Who Can’t, and many more. Goldthwait has directed numerous standup comedy specials for folks like Patton Oswalt, Marc Maron, Ron Funches, Kyle Kinane, Cameron Esposito, Mo Willems, Gary Gulman, Hari Kondabolu, Eugene Mirman, and Pete Davidson to name a few. Flirtations and Fangs runs Saturdays at 6:00 pm from October 3rd through October 31st. Reserve your tickets. . . before they mysteriously disappear. Improvised Jane Austen will return to their classic show in November.

This October, Improvised Jane Austen swaps Darcy for Dracula! It’s time to celebrate the scariest season of all: even the refined Jane Austen enjoyed sitting down with a spooky gothic novel (think Twilight, but with even MORE melodrama). Improvised Jane Austen presents: Flirtations and Fangs, an improvised regency rom-com with everyone's favorite love interest: vampires. Experience gothic elements blended with Jane Austen’s signature romantic comedy and social satire. Join us for a witty evening of fright with a little extra bite!

"...countless laughs...whimsical homage to the illustrious author." -- Chicago Reader

Improvised Jane Austen is a comedic ensemble that creates unscripted performances using Jane Austen's tropes, themes, and language to craft a satirical romantic comedy set in Regency-era England. Playing in Austen’s world, Improvised Jane Austen’s stories delight 21st century audiences with a modern sense and sensibility. Come for the humor (and horror), stay for the heart!

"...[They] took it, owned it and created some really funny and touching moments....an evening of silliness and indulgence....make running amok look like delicious fun." -- PerformInk Chicago

Throughout the show’s run, Improvised Jane Austen has been Chicago Reader Recommended, named a PerformInk Critics’ Pick, voted Best sketch/improv troupe 2019 in the Reader’s Best of Chicago, and was featured on WTTW playlist, in Time Out, the Chicago Tribune and on a their list of what to do on Valentine’s Day, on WGN’s Daytime Chicago in 2024 and 2026 and on CBS News Chicago.
